$comment: The public transparency surface (§E18), source language. Its own namespace because §16.2's audience is journalists, RTI applicants and residents rather than the people who file reports — the register is different, and a namespace is the unit the Phase 5 locale registry overrides. Nothing here is a colour, a number, or a format. Nothing here restates a sentence the API returns: `notice` and `rating_disclaimer` are the server's own words and are rendered verbatim, because paraphrasing a §22.2 disclaimer would be substituting our legal text for theirs.
city.what: Every figure on these pages is computed from reports filed by residents. Nothing here is edited by hand.
city.otherPlaces: Zones and the city as a whole
city.notPublishing: This city does not publish transparency data.
city.notPublishingWhy: Publishing is a decision each city takes for itself, and this one has not taken it. There is nothing withheld here — there is nothing here.
place.noCentroid: This place has no mapped boundary yet, so there is no centre to state.
place.notFound: No published place has that code.
place.notFoundWhy: It may belong to a different city, or the city may have stopped publishing it. Neither is something this page can tell you apart, on purpose.
figure.autoConfirmedWhy: Counted separately because a closure nobody confirmed is a weaker fact than one somebody did.
figure.noneWhy: Nothing has been reported here. That is a genuine zero, not a withheld one.
figure.unknownWhy: There is nothing to average yet.
breakdown.title: What was reported
breakdown.empty: No category has enough reports to publish.
breakdown.hidden.one: One more category is held back because it has fewer than {threshold} reports.
breakdown.hidden.other: {count} more categories are held back because each has fewer than {threshold} reports.
contractor.title: {name} — the record
contractor.activeSinceUnknown: The date this contractor joined the register was not recorded.
contractor.notFound: No published contractor has that identifier.
contractor.responseNone: This contractor has not been asked to respond to anything.
budget.title: {place} — money
budget.empty: No allocation has been recorded against this place for {year}.
budget.emptyWhy: The ledger is published as it is kept. An empty year here means nothing has been entered, not that nothing was spent.
budget.notSuppressed: Budget lines are never withheld. Public money is a fact about a municipality, not an observation about anyone who reported a pothole.
honesty.title: What is real, what is not
honesty.lede: Every product claim in this system carries a status label, and the labels are published rather than kept internally. A claim that is not on this table has not been made.
honesty.why: Most systems in this category overclaim. Publishing the table is how this one stays checkable — §6 Principle #8.
honesty.legendReal: Running against real data on a live stack, with a test that fails when it stops.
honesty.legendSimulated: The shape is real and the values are seeded. Named here rather than demonstrated quietly.
honesty.legendRoadmap: Designed and not built. It does not exist in the running system.
honesty.legendCut: Considered and dropped, with the reason recorded.
honesty.legendReframed: The claim itself was withdrawn and renamed. v1.0 called three pipeline stages "agents"; v2.0 stopped, and the row records that it did.
